tei:div.tei:p: 427) bcom ldan dbang gi lha mos rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam phan bde'i 'byung gnas bzhugs: hoḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus bcom ldan ma: don dam lhan skyes gnyis med dbang gi lha: rje btsun rig byed lha mo rgya skyegs mdangs: ting 'dzin gsum la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor gyis: bcom ldan ma yi gsang gsum rgyan 'khor nas: yon tan yongs rdzogs bskyed pa mthar phyin shog: gnas lnga'i 'khor lo lnga yi mdud rgya khrol: rlung sems dbang thob kha sbyor dbu mar thim: gtum mo'i me yis kun rtog bag chags bsregs: rtsa rlung thig le gnas dag las su rung: pho nya'i lam gyis bde stong ye shes sbar: dga' bzhis nyer drangs stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon: mi slob shes rab mchog thob ye shes kyis: gdod nas ma 'khrul sangs rgyas mngon 'gyur shog: lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag yongs rdzogs nas: khams gsum dbang 'dus mthong thos dran reg gi: skye 'gro ma lus bdag gis 'dul nas kyang: rlabs chen tshogs gnyis lam la 'god nus shog: chags 428)med chags bral sor rtogs ye shes lha: mtshan thos tsam gyis bde stong ye shes bskyed: mthong bas gsal stong lhan skyes ye shes mjal: bsam pas rig stong ting 'dzin ye shes rgyas: bsgoms pas ye stong spros bral mngon du gyur: 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur ye shes dbang mo yi: thugs rje lcags kyus dus kun rjes 'dzin shog: skye ba kun tu rje btsun lha mo dang: 'bral med 'khor 'das dpal la longs spyod nas: sa dang lam bgrod rim par mi ltos par: lhan skyes bde stong ye shes dbang 'byor zhing: bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob nas: mngon gyur dang po'i sangs rgyas rab thob shog: mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa bslu med dang: rig byed lha mo'i thugs rje'i nus pa dang: bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus: smon lam 'di btab yongs su 'grub gyur cig:

gang gi rang bzhin 'dus ma byas: chos dbyings ngang las g.yo ba med: lhun grub rol rtsal sgyu ma'i 'phrul: thugs rje tshad med ye shes kyi: rnam kun mchog ldan btsun mo che: kun bzang dbang gi lha mor bzhengs: bdag gis sgrib gnyis mthar byas mthus: rang byung klong nas rang zhal mjal: sku gsum ngo bo nyid kyis dbyings: 429)gnyis med gcig gi ngang du grol: rjes 'jug mos pa'i bu'i don phyir: lha mos rjes 'dzin smon lam 'di: kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo zhes: smyon ma gang shar rang grol gyis: rang byung rin chen shog skya la: sug rtse rlung la bskyon te bris: don dam lag tu longs dang gsal: rjes 'jug bstan 'gro'i btsas su shog: dam nyams log lta can la ni: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bka' rgya yod: snang ba drag rtsal ra hu la: stong dbyings drag mo e ka dza: zung 'jug thig le badz+ra rtsal: bdag gi bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: dam nyams rnams la lto zhal ngoms: dam ldan bu la stong grogs mdzod: bde chen pad+ma las 'brel dang: mi dmigs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i: zung 'jug mthar phyin bstan pa rgyas: phyogs las rnam rgyal phrin las mdzod: rdo rje'i dam las ma 'da' zhig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yid bzhin nor bu'i bzhed skong du su kha badz+ra gyis so: hrīḥ bcom ldan dbang gi lha mo khyed bsgrub na: gsang sngags rten 'brel zab mo'i nus pa'i mthus: bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sol: rim gnyis mtha' ru phyin par mdzad du gsol: mkhyen rab snang ba'i sgo brgya rab bye nas: theg pa'i chos kun ma lus khong chud de: dge 'dun sde 'phel bshad sgrub mthar rgyas shing: rim gnyis 430)sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan dar bar mdzod: dmigs pa'i 'od zer dbang gi lcags kyu yis: srid pa'i skye dgu'i blo yid dbang du sdus: mthun rkyen legs tshogs gang brtsam yongs 'grub nas: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rab rgyas gong 'phel mdzod:

ma rig rkyen snang dgra bgegs dbang bsdus nas: bsam pa'i don la bar chad mi 'byung zhing: log 'dren rdul brlag dbang drag phrin las kun: ma khyod thugs rje'i nus pas 'grub par mdzodaḥ rig pa ye shes chen po'i don rtogs pas: mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzod: thabs shes spyod pa rlabs chen mthar phyin te: 'bras bu chos nyid gzhi la sad par mdzod: thun mong khams gsum ma lus dbang sdud nas: las gang dmigs pa bdag gis dbang sdud mdzod: mtha' yas rgyas 'gro kun ma lus 'dul nas kyang: khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor dbyings su zhig: bde chen rnam dag zhing du 'khod nas kyang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par mdzad du gsol: bcom ldan dbang gi lha mo'i thugs rje dang: bdag gi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i bden 'bras mthus: 'dod don ma lus myur du 'grub pa dang: 431) bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs dpal thob mdzod: ces pa 'khor 'bangs tha shal ba su kha badz+ra gyis nyams chos yig gzugs su bkod pa'o/ 432)
